name: Saint’s Ring
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Slot ring; Price 13,300 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is charged with divine power granting the user minor healing abilities. The wearer can use cure light wounds (healing 1d8+5 hit points of damage) 3/day.

If the wearer is ever killed, all of the ring’s power is channeled into the wearer’s body, granting the effects of breath of life (healing the wearer for 5d8+9 hit points of damage). If this occurs, the ring disintegrates.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells cure light wounds, breath of life; Cost 6,750 gp

Identification DC 24
